_comment: Claims a business has confirmed it can back, per site. Everything in scripts/check-claims.mjs BANNED is refused everywhere unless it is listed here. Confirmations are per business and never transfer between sites: a credential verified for one operator says nothing about another. Record who confirmed it and when, so a future reader can tell evidence from assumption.
_how_to_add: Ask the owner about that specific site. If the answer is yes, add the kind to its 'allow' array with a dated note. If the answer is unclear, leave it out - the copy is rewritten to avoid the claim instead, which is what happened on Dallas before it was confirmed.
